title: Beparda shaam ki
body:
haye zainab haye baazar
<<DIVIDER>>
be parda shaam ki galiyon mein
tatheer ki chaadar waali hai
khoton se baraste hai patthar
athara baradar waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ki jo maajayi hai
wo qaidi ban ke aayi hai
ek jashn bapa bazar mein hai
namoos e payambar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar zakhmi hai zakhmi hai badan
be chadar hai haathon mein rasan
jurrat bhi shuja'at bhi lekin
abbas e dilawar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
be gor o kafan islam tha jab
de kar chadar boli zainab
ye saari sakhawat khoon mein mere
taaseer ye hyder waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
durron ki aziyat sehti hui
taa shaam gayi ye kehti hui
ye khutbon ki talwaar nahi
tehreer ye shabbar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt azan raahon mein suni
sar dhaamp ke haathon se boli
ay nana din ye dard ke hai
ye baat muqaddar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka sar naize se gira
sar zainab ka dekha jo khula
ye taaza musibat ghazi par
shamsheer sikandar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar e sitam mein shahzadi
pahunchi to qayamat barpa thi
har ek sitamgar kehta tha
ye saa'at mehshar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi sakina ro ro kar
kab jayenge zindan se ghar
zainab ne kaha ye baat na kar
ye chot hai khanjar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay nasir ay rehan e aza
zainab ko ye keh kar do pursa
ye ashk nahi ruk sakte kabhi
ye mauj samandar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
author: Rehaan Azmi
